observations.setup_run1: No application was launched: copied helper binary was missing beside the new harness; retained as a setup failure.
observations.setup_run2: The fixture reached R630_READY. It reported window origin (0,0), client size 1022x731, visibility value 5 (Qt FullScreen), active=false, probe center (340,220), and launcher center (170,40).
observations.broad_RESULTADO_note: The broad catalog workflow had no native state report after the probe exited before R624_LAYOUT; its failed checks are not treated as Kicker behavior acceptance.

interpretation.conclusion: The fake-input client authenticated and sent requests, but the full-screen host reported active=false and no QML pointer handler observed either the known-coordinate probe click or the launcher click. This indicates the fixture did not establish a verified active input target. It neither reproduces nor refutes the reported Kicker hover-close or search-focus symptoms.
